text: We had an amazing experience at Cerámica 1920. Beatriz is a very helpful and attentive teacher for any class or experience you are looking for. She also knows many different languages and is very kind. You can choose whichever design you want to create, and you can even make your own. I ended up making a very cool tile!

title: Music, Laughter, and Shoes
text: I had such a wonderful time making my espadrilles. Fer, who led the workshop, was brilliant and taught me all about the origin of the shoes. title: Local and typical Spanish activity to do!
text:
Alejandra, our host welcomed my sister, an English-speaking tourist and myself with her joie de vivre and good humor!
She began by telling us about the origin of espadrilles, whose real name is “espardeñas”, as well as the different styles of espadrilles. 
For the workshop, we made the “Pamplona” style, according to Alejandra it was not the easiest, but the most adaptable for beginners that we are. And I confirm, it was not obvious!
There is a certain technique to master, a bit like the hook, but as soon as we have picked up the trick, it goes by itself. 
In 2 hours, we had finished our pairs
author: Voyageavecvirginia
